text: これは　あいてに　きょうふを　あたえる　わざ　なのだ！

structure.jp: あいてに　きょうふを　あたえる　わざ
structure.en: a move that gives fear to the opponent

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あいてに　きょうふを　あたえる　わざ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, put right in front of a thing, tells you what kind of thing it is. あいてに　きょうふを　あたえる　わざ = 'a move that gives the opponent fear'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end makes the sentence sound like a firm explanation; after a thing it becomes なのだ. わざ　なのだ = 'it is a move, you see'.
